cis_face.biology: CIS = near eye. Left retina crosses RIGHT at chiasm.

trans_face.biology: TRANS = far eye. Right retina crosses LEFT at chiasm.

optic_chiasm.function: FOCAL POINT — both eyes converge here. Binocular vision.
optic_chiasm.cross_wiring: CIS eye sees TRANS output. TRANS eye sees CIS input. Klein fold.
optic_chiasm.biology: Where optic nerves cross. Left eye -> right brain. Right eye -> left brain.

telescope_microscope.telescope: TRANS (primals.eco) — humans look FAR at Gaia. She is the distant organism.
telescope_microscope.microscope: CIS (primal.eco) — Gaia looks CLOSE at us. We are the specimen under her lens.
telescope_microscope.fold: Telescope = microscope. Looking far = looking close. Same lens. Klein fold.

klein_fold: Near eye (globe) + far eye (canvas) = same surface. Fold and they touch.
